description: The gravel Discord bot: the gateway, interactions against Discord's three seconds, role sync, Linked Roles, the server cards, the mod log, seeding, the presence card, the session recaps, the go-live posts, the Steam news, the match results, the moderation command and the Go runtime (gravel docs/bot.md, Observability).

panels.description: Ready while the gateway session is up; also 0 when the bot runs without the gateway.
panels.title: Gateway

panels.description: No data is expected when the gateway is off or not ready.
panels.gravelOptional: the gateway is off or not ready
panels.title: Gateway latency

panels.description: No data is expected when Linked Roles are off (linked_roles.enabled).
panels.gravelOptional: Linked Roles are off (linked_roles.enabled)
panels.title: Linked Roles schema

panels.description: Orange after 20 minutes and red after 30 (two and three default intervals). No data is expected when role sync is off.
panels.gravelOptional: role sync is off
panels.title: Since the last role sync pass

panels.description: No data is expected when the gateway is off or not ready.
panels.gravelOptional: the gateway is off or not ready
panels.title: Gateway heartbeat latency

panels.description: No data is expected when no interaction arrived in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no interaction arrived in the range
panels.title: Interactions by route and result

panels.description: Discord waits three seconds for the first answer; the red line is that deadline. No data is expected when no interaction arrived in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no interaction arrived in the range
panels.title: Interaction latency

panels.description: No data is expected when no interaction arrived in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no interaction arrived in the range

targets.expr: (sum by (route) (rate(gravel_bot_interactions_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (route) (rate(gravel_bot_interactions_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (route) (rate(gravel_bot_interactions_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Interaction error ratio

panels.description: idle means no mapping: the pass had nothing to do. No data is expected when role sync is off.
panels.gravelOptional: role sync is off
panels.title: Role sync passes

panels.description: forbidden: the role sits above the bot's; gone: the member left first; dry_run: logged, not made. No data is expected when role sync is off or changed nothing in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: role sync is off or changed nothing in the range
panels.title: Role changes

panels.description: No data is expected when no job ended in the range (jobs run until shutdown).
panels.gravelOptional: no job ended in the range (jobs run until shutdown)
panels.title: Background jobs ended

panels.description: A pass that brought every card up to date (or found none placed). Orange after a minute, red after five: a card that keeps failing keeps this growing. No data is expected when the server cards are off.
panels.gravelOptional: the server cards are off
panels.title: Since the last server card pass

panels.description: posted: a card that was not in its channel; edited: a card that changed; forbidden: the bot may not use the channel; error: Discord failed, retried at the next pass. No data is expected when the server cards are off or changed nothing in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: the server cards are off or changed nothing in the range
panels.title: Server card updates

panels.description: A pass that posted every finished audit-log entry (or found no channel set). Orange after two minutes, red after ten: Discord refusing or the hub away keeps this growing. No data is expected when the mod log is off.
panels.gravelOptional: the mod log is off
panels.title: Since the last mod log pass

panels.description: posted: an audit-log entry copied to the channel; forbidden: the bot may not read or post there; error: Discord failed, retried at the next pass. No data is expected when the mod log is off or nothing was moderated in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: the mod log is off or nothing was moderated in the range
panels.title: Mod log posts

panels.description: posted: a call pinged the seeder role; forbidden: the bot may not post in the channel; error: Discord failed, retried at the next pass. No data is expected when seeding is off or no call went out in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: seeding is off or no call went out in the range
panels.title: Seeding calls

panels.description: started: a call opened a session; reached: the server reached its floor; window_closed: the window ended first. No data is expected when seeding is off or no session started or ended in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: seeding is off or no session started or ended in the range
panels.title: Seeding sessions

panels.description: The seconds of seeding recorded as participation when sessions ended, every player together; a duplicate (a retry, a restart) is not counted. No data is expected when seeding is off or no session ended in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: seeding is off or no session ended in the range
panels.title: Seeding time recorded

panels.description: Failed attempts to record seeding minutes. They are retried every pass; an event the hub calls invalid is dropped alone and logged. A line that keeps rising is the hub away or the bot's app without participation:write. No data is expected when nothing failed to record in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nothing failed to record in the range
panels.title: Seeding record errors

panels.description: Members Discord shows playing each game on the presence card, at each pass. Only members who share their activity on Discord are seen; nothing about who is kept. No data is expected when presence is off, places no card, or the bot can't see presences.
panels.gravelOptional: presence is off, places no card, or the bot can't see presences
panels.title: Playing now

panels.description: Members in the bot's live view, online and playing anything; held in memory only. No data is expected when presence is off.
panels.gravelOptional: presence is off
panels.title: Members seen playing

panels.description: Orange after 5 minutes and red after 15 (five and fifteen default intervals). It also stalls while the gateway hasn't delivered the guild. No data is expected when presence is off.
panels.gravelOptional: presence is off
panels.title: Since the last presence pass

panels.description: A privileged intent a module asks for and the application isn't allowed in the Developer Portal (Bot, Privileged Gateway Intents). The bot runs without it; turn it on and restart the bot. No data is expected when no module asks for a privileged intent.
panels.gravelOptional: no module asks for a privileged intent
panels.title: Privileged intents left out

panels.description: posted or edited: a count changed; forbidden: the bot may not read or post in the channel; error: Discord failed, retried at the next pass. No data is expected when presence is off or no count changed in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: presence is off or no count changed in the range
panels.title: Presence card updates

panels.description: posted: a recap went out after a window; nobody: nobody was on, so nothing was posted; forbidden: the bot may not read or post in the channel; error: the hub or Discord failed, retried at the next pass. No data is expected when recaps are off or no window ended in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: recaps are off or no window ended in the range
panels.title: Recaps

panels.description: Orange after 5 minutes and red after 15 (five and fifteen default intervals); a recap that keeps failing holds it. No data is expected when recaps are off.
panels.gravelOptional: recaps are off
panels.title: Since the last recaps pass

panels.description: The listed streamers each platform says are live, at its last answer. No data is expected when go-live posts are off or no platform has answered.
panels.gravelOptional: go-live posts are off or no platform has answered
panels.title: Live now

panels.description: Orange after 5 minutes and red after 15 (five and fifteen default intervals): a platform failing, rate-limiting or refusing the application, or a post failing. A post waits for the next good pass. No data is expected when go-live posts are off.
panels.gravelOptional: go-live posts are off
panels.title: Since the last good streams pass

panels.description: ok; throttled: a 429, the platform is not asked again until its Retry-After; unauthorized: the platform refuses the application (check streams.<platform> in bot.yaml); error: anything else, retried next pass. No data is expected when go-live posts are off.
panels.gravelOptional: go-live posts are off
panels.title: Platform answers

panels.description: posted: a stream started (the role is pinged); resumed: a stream came back within ten minutes and its post went live again; ended: the post was edited after the stream; forbidden: the bot may not post in the channel; error: Discord failed, retried next pass. No data is expected when go-live posts are off or nobody streamed in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: go-live posts are off or nobody streamed in the range
panels.title: Go-live posts

panels.description: Steam announcements posted, by app id. posted: an announcement went out; failed: Discord refused or failed the post, which is retried at the next pass (the log says which). No data is expected when news is off or Steam announced nothing in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: news is off or Steam announced nothing in the range
panels.title: News posts

panels.description: The stalest feed. Orange after an hour and red after three (four and twelve default intervals): Steam failing or rate-limiting the bot, a channel the bot can't read, or a post failing. No data is expected when news is off.
panels.gravelOptional: news is off
panels.title: Since the last good news pass

panels.description: Finished match results (ADR-0024). posted: a result went out; error: the hub, the channel or the post failed, and what is left waits for the next pass (the log says which, once). No data is expected when match results are off or no series ended in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: match results are off or no series ended in the range
panels.title: Match result posts

panels.description: Orange after 5 minutes and red after 15 (five and fifteen default intervals): the hub refusing the bot (stats:read while stats are private), a channel the bot can't use, or a post failing. No data is expected when match results are off.
panels.gravelOptional: match results are off
panels.title: Since the last good match results pass

panels.description: A pass that posted every event the settings' filter takes (or found no channel set; gravel#200). Orange after two minutes, red after ten: Discord refusing or the hub away keeps this growing. No data is expected when the events feed is off.
panels.gravelOptional: the events feed is off
panels.title: Since the last events pass

panels.description: posted: an event copied to the channel; forbidden: the bot may not read or post there; error: Discord failed, retried at the next pass. No data is expected when the events feed is off or nothing passed its filter in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: the events feed is off or nothing passed its filter in the range
panels.title: Events posted

panels.description: Confirmed clicks by action and outcome: ok; refused (the hub said no: not an operator of the game, the host busy); failed (the hub could not be reached). Each one the hub took is in its audit log and events. No data is expected when nobody used the buttons in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nobody used the buttons in the range
panels.title: Restart and Park from Discord

panels.description: Actions moderators confirmed from Discord, by action and result: ok; refused (the hub said no: not a moderator, the player left, not offered); failed (the hub could not be reached); cancelled; expired (a confirmation answered after two minutes). Every confirmed action is also in the hub's audit log. No data is expected when the moderation command is off or nobody used it in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: the moderation command is off or nobody used it in the range
panels.title: Moderation commands

title: gravel bot
